runtime.name: codex-repository-marketplace
runtime.configuration: Official repository-marketplace copy layout exercised in a disposable temporary repository root.
runtime.permissionProfile: Writes restricted to a disposable temporary marketplace root.

assertions.evidence: The generated package and marketplace entry were created in a new temporary repository layout.
Atomic replacement removed a stale plugin-owned file and preserved a user-owned sibling sentinel.
Removal deleted only the plugin and its catalog entry while preserving the user-owned sentinel.
Both root portable plugin.json and .codex-plugin/plugin.json compatibility manifests were present and named oh-my-stack.

limitations: This validates the official repository-marketplace filesystem lifecycle without changing the user's configured marketplaces or plugin cache.
Live Codex discovery and invocation are covered by the related prove-it-works evidence.
